name: devmesh
description: An evidence-based AI software engineering and website-delivery orchestration framework with Design-to-Code Studio, Website Product Builder, Codex and ChatGPT adapters, Mission Control, full-stack development, website/agency operations, WordPress, IDX/MLS/RESO, QA, and delivery.

interface.shortDescription: AI Design-to-Code + Website Product Builder Mission Control
interface.longDescription: DevMesh v1.3 adds Design-to-Code Studio for screenshot, mockup, Figma/export, and visual-reference implementation with observed/inferred/unknown evidence labels, design-token extraction, responsive-layout inference, component architecture, Browser QA, visual fidelity judging, and bounded repair. It builds on v1.2 Website Product Builder, full-stack engineering, Mission Control, Agency Operations, Website Operations, WordPress Real Estate, IDX/MLS/RESO, security, accessibility, performance, CI, deployment, incident response, review, memory, reporting, and Git delivery.
defaultPrompt: DevMesh Design-to-Code: recreate this supplied design as a maintainable responsive website, separate observed from inferred behavior, and verify rendered fidelity when tools allow.
DevMesh Website Product Builder: build this website from scratch from product contract through design system, sitemap, UI architecture, implementation, SEO, QA, and production delivery.
DevMesh Agency Deep: audit all client websites, prioritize incidents and maintenance, and create a site-specific action queue with evidence.
